paper_title: Novel Constraints on Axions Produced in Pulsar Polar-Cap Cascades
notes: Paper (arXiv:2209.09917, Noordhuis, Prabhu, Witte et al.) derives 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma from axions produced in polar-cap cascades of 27 nearby pulsars converting resonantly to radio photons. Limits are the strongest to date for 1e-8 eV < m_a < 1e-5 eV and explicitly do NOT assume axions are dark matter (hence dm_density_assumed = null). No numerical table of the exclusion curve is provided in the extracted content; data_points are approximate values read from the description of Fig. 2 (fiducial limit, weaker of the PIC-simulation and semi-analytic model at each mass, roughly flat at a few x 1e-12 GeV^-1 at low masses, rising toward ~1e-10 GeV^-1 near 1e-5 eV). Coupling type is unambiguous (g_agamma throughout), but the numerical values carry figure-reading uncertainty; systematic modeling band spans roughly a factor of ~2 in coupling. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
